source: day 1 09:01Z to day 2 06:45Z, my PR #102: a hand-written fix task sent with raw `send`, a report as a long note, a second round delegated with the next PR, then a third round re-delegated as a whole task ('Follow-up to the earlier fix task') to the same busy window.

steps.why: the real day-1 hand-written task over raw send

run: bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' changes-requested --note '4 unresolved CodeQL threads'
bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' addressing --note 'fix-my-pr delegated to exporter-tax'

bosun delegate fix-my-pr --id 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' --link https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/102 --requester 'github-advanced-security (CodeQL)' --ask 'Address the 4 unresolved CodeQL review threads; explain false positives in the reply' --window exporter-tax
out: dry-run: would deliver to replay:exporter-tax: Ledger id: mypr:acme/exporter#102

steps.why: the outcome as a report instead of a long note
steps.run: bosun ledger report 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' --summary 'Fixed the 6 CodeQL findings in 2 commits; answered every thread' --result https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/102 --result 0000002abc --result 0000003abc
bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' awaiting-review --note 'fixes pushed; review requested' --field last_push_at=2026-03-12T09:03:00Z

steps.why: day 2: the real round for #102 and #103 together
the second round's outcome, with what is left
steps.run: bosun ledger report 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' --summary 'Pushed 1 commit: a test for zero-amount lines; answered the open thread' --result 0000004abc --open 'Lena requested changes with 4 threads this task did not cover'

steps.why: the third round as an update to the same window, not a second task
run: Lena requested changes (4 open threads: credit-note rounding order, tax subtotal header, a mixed-currency test, a stale docstring). Address them as for the earlier threads; queue this after the #103 work in progress.
out: Update to ledger item mypr:acme/exporter#102 (the fix-my-pr task

steps.run: bosun ledger report 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' --summary 'Pushed 4 commits; answered the 4 threads and a summary comment' --result https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/102 --open 're-review by Lena and Priya; #104 rebases onto this after merge'

steps.why: the next check-in reads the open points
and sees which delegated work has not reported

mypr:acme/exporter#102.report_open: re-review by Lena and Priya; #104 rebases onto this after merge
